title: Asymptotic stability of Cayley graphs on abelian groups
summary: For a finite group $G$, we say that a Cayley graph $Γ$ on $G$ is a most rigid representation (MRR) of $G$ if its full automorphism group has the smallest possible order among all Cayley graphs on $G$, and say that $Γ$ is stable if every automorphism of $Γ\times K_2$ comes from $\mathrm{Aut}(Γ)\times\Aut(K_2)$. Although the study of stability has attracted significant attention, particularly regarding Cayley graphs on abelian groups, a complete classification is currently out of reach even for Cayley graphs on cyclic groups.
